description: Use when your user wants a device to become usable with open code but will not reverse engineer it themselves (lookup_device found nothing usable). Returns the existing request to add a 👍 to, or a pre-filled link to a new public GitHub issue that the user reviews and submits. Read-only: this tool never posts anything.

goal.description: What your user wants to do with it, in their words (e.g. "fly it from Python now that the app is gone").

name: request_device
title: Request a device (say your user wants it)
